pr.title: Refactor historical price feature
pr.body: prior_mean(prices, index, window): at the start of index, use only the preceding window prices; index >= window > 0 and index < len(prices).

base_files.module.py:
def prior_mean(prices, index, window):
    return sum(prices[index-window:index]) / window

changed_files.patch:
--- a/module.py
+++ b/module.py
@@ -1,2 +1,4 @@
 def prior_mean(prices, index, window):
-    return sum(prices[index-window:index]) / window
+    start = index - window
+    history = prices[start:index]
+    return sum(history) / len(history)

findings.description: The new implementation does not handle cases where 'index' is less than 'window'. This will lead to an IndexError when trying to access 'prices[start:index]' if 'start' is negative.

decisions.rationale: index < window is out of contract, and a negative slice start does not by itself raise IndexError.

normalization_notes: Reviewed final JSON, submitted body and inline comments together. Merged the same allegation across channels; retained all distinct defect allegations.
